transferProblems.problem: The GitHub workflow has id-token write and actions/attest, but npm has no trusted-publisher relationship. Which state may advance?
transferProblems.answer: The bounded RC mechanism may become archive-ready when its tasks and evidence pass. npm authority and stable publication remain blocked because workflow intent does not create package-side authorization or an attestation.

transferProblems.problem: npm staging succeeds, but Pub.dev publisher configuration is absent. May the project claim full stable 3.0?
transferProblems.answer: No. Record the new npm lane evidence, but keep cross-ecosystem certification and stable publication blocked until Pub.dev authority, every other mandatory lane, the immutable evidence bundle, and explicit release approval are present.
